Re: Account reference: ACC-406327

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter requesting validation and a cease and desist on the above-referenced account. We understand your request for documentation confirming the debt.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a written validation notice within five days of your dispute. We will investigate your dispute and provide a written validation notice with the required information.

We have reviewed the account records and can confirm that the account is owned by Apex Auto Finance and was charged off on 2021-08-05. The current balance on the account is $33.66. The last payment made on the account was on 2023-06-22.

We will provide you with a written validation notice within the next five days, as required by law. This notice will include the name of the creditor, the amount of the debt, and a statement that unless you dispute the validity of the debt, we will assume it is valid.

You have the right to dispute the validity of the debt and request a copy of the contract or agreement with the original creditor. However, we have no record of a request for validation being made prior to your current dispute.

We will investigate your dispute and take the necessary actions as required by law.
